Alger, 29 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech): Algiers, September 29, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Djezzy and the Algérie Presse Service agency formalized on Tuesday the launch of the Daily Brief solution, an offering dedicated to the B2B segment providing a daily news summary.
L'opérateur de téléphonie et l'agence de: The mobile operator and the public news agency carried out the official launch of the Daily Brief service in Algiers. The ceremony took place in the presence of APS Director General Samir Gaïd and Djezzy Director General Boumediene Senouci, accompanied by executives from both structures.
Cette prestation s'adresse spécifiquemen: This service is specifically aimed at professional clients. It provides them with a daily, structured, and synthetic overview of the main information flows from the national agency's newswire.
Un partenariat stratégique orienté vers: A strategic partnership focused on digital
Cette solution concrétise la première ré: This solution represents the first achievement resulting from the partnership agreement signed between the two entities on November 12, 2025. The system combines the agency's editorial expertise and the operator's technological infrastructure to meet the demands of the professional world in terms of monitoring.
De son côté, l'opérateur développe son c: For its part, the operator is expanding its catalog of solutions to support the digital transformation of economic players. For the public agency, this project reflects a desire to modernize distribution channels and enhance the value of national and international content for the economic sphere.
